title: GTA 6 Has a UFO. Your Eyes Can Make One Too

shots.narration: In GTA 6, players say a UFO shows up on a dark road after two in the morning.
Your own eyes can make one too.
Two a.m. Nia and Kai are camping. Just stars.
Nia points. That light is moving. Kai stares. It drifts left. Then down.
Kai grabs his phone. On the screen, the light is perfectly still.
Wait. Did it move or not?
Your eyes are never perfectly still. And in the dark, one small light has nothing next to it to compare with.
So your brain blames the light. It's called the autokinetic effect. It was described over a hundred years ago.
In the nineteen thirties, people alone in a dark room watched one still dot. They saw it wander.
Put a branch next to the light, and it stops.
The Pentagon reviewed almost eighty years of UFO investigations. No evidence of alien technology. Mostly ordinary things.
Next night, Kai lines the light up with a branch. It's a planet. It never moved. Nia isn't convinced.
So, what have you seen in the sky?
